scope: Completed normalized-carry/accounting independent review; packaging only, no new Lean execution.
archive_metadata_policy: File bytes and modes are retained. Archive mtime, owner names and IDs are normalized; original mtime_ns and mode are recorded for every file below.
excluded_scope_policy: Only compiled products or interpreter caches within the review root are excluded. The generated evidence-package directory is outside the original evidence selection to prevent recursion.
external_runtime_policy: The Lean runtime binaries are not bundled. The exact runtime recovery receipt, official archive hash, original smoke source/log, compiler hashes, and commands are retained. Older source paths in that historical runtime receipt are not the present source binding.
